workflows.name: 01 | Amazon Audit → Speed To Lead
workflows.trigger: Inbound Webhook (funnel form) OR Form Submitted: "Amazon Audit"
workflows.goal: First touch in under 60 seconds; a booked call before the lead goes cold.

actions.detail: Map first_name, email, phone, website, monthly_revenue + all utm_* fields to contact & custom fields.
Hey {{contact.first_name}}, it's {{user.first_name}} from BAD Marketing. Got your request! Grab a time on my calendar here so we can dig into your numbers: {{custom_values.booking_link}}
SMS + Slack to assigned rep: "🔥 New {{contact.monthly_revenue}} lead: {{contact.name}} {{contact.phone}}"
If appointment booked → end. Else → Call contact (rep whisper: "New funnel lead, press 1 to connect").

workflows.name: 02 | Amazon Audit Call → Show-Up Machine
workflows.goal: Show rate 75%+. Every reminder gives them a reason to show, not just a time.

actions.detail: Subject: "You're confirmed, {{contact.first_name}} (read before our call)". Include 3-min prep video + what to have ready.
You're locked in for {{appointment.start_time}}. Reply YES to confirm so we keep your spot 👊
Tomorrow at {{appointment.only_start_time}}: here's the agenda + one quick question so we can prep your audit.
Heads up, we're on in 2 hours. Meeting link: {{appointment.meeting_location}}
Hey {{contact.first_name}}, looks like we missed each other. All good, life happens. Want to grab another time? {{custom_values.booking_link}}
Subject: "Still want that audit?" with a case study + reschedule button.
Last nudge from me. Should I close out your file or keep your audit open?
No reply → Opportunity "Lost: No Show", add tag nurture-long-term.
